summary.text: Bill Bolton is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 8 who has held the seat since December 7, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An IT consultant who spent a career in New Hampshire state government, he lives in Plymouth.

paragraphs.text: Bill Bolton lives in Plymouth, New Hampshire, graduated from Mountain Lakes High School, and earned a B.S. in marine biology from Fairleigh Dickinson University in 1975.

His career included state government roles as assistant director of the public health laboratories, chief of staff supporting the Health Services Planning and Review Board, and state registrar and director of the division of vital records administration under the secretary of state.
After retiring from state government, Bolton worked as an at-home software implementation manager and was appointed executive director of Transport Central.
Bolton assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 7, 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session, he was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee.
